newsitem.title: USA: Texas natural gas in storage climbs - regulators.
newsitem.headline: Texas natural gas in storage climbs - regulators.

text.p: Natural gas in storage in Texas stood at 162.5 billion cubic feet (bcf) in mid-May, up from 143.9 bcf at the end of April and 97.85 bcf in April 1996, the Texas Railroad Commission said on Wednesday.

The commission, which regulates natural gas production in the state, set June production allowables for prorated fields at 1.93 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd). By comparison, June 1996 actual production was 1.89 bcfd.
